newsitem.title: ITALY: Many amendments tabled to Italy mini-budget.
newsitem.headline: Many amendments tabled to Italy mini-budget.

text.p: A huge number of amendments have been presented on the government's mini-budget, which is currently under examination by the budget committee of the Chamber of Deputies (lower house), parliamentary sources said.

Around 1,300 amendments come from the federalist Northern League party, 500 from the centre-right opposition Freedom Alliance and 30 from parties within the centre-left government coalition, the sources said.

The mini-budget, which the cabinet approved at the end of March, envisages 15.5 trillion lire of budget deficit and measures and would help Italy to meet tough economic criteria for joining a single European currency in 1999.
The committee president will judge by Wednesday which amendments are admissable and the committee will start examining those amendments tomorrow with the aim of finishing its work on Thursday.
The mini-budget is expected to go to the full chamber on April 28.
